source_clauses: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine, and when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement: shall send a signal to the machine when pressed
shall return to its resting position on its own every time the foot is removed
shall not move when brushed sideways

scenarios.description: The user presses the pedal to send a signal.
The user removes their foot and the pedal returns to resting position.
Something brushes against the pedal sideways and the pedal does not move.

actors.name: user
actors.description: presses the pedal and removes foot

actors.name: something
actors.description: an unspecified object that brushes sideways against the pedal

freedoms: The design of the foot pedal is not specified in terms of mechanism, material, or dimensions.
The location of the pedal relative to the workbench is not specified.
The signal type (e.g., electrical, mechanical) is not specified.
ambiguities: It is unclear what 'move' means in the context of sideways brushing - whether it refers to any displacement or only activation.
It is unclear what constitutes 'sideways' relative to the pedal orientation.
assumptions: The machine is the recipient of the signal.
The foot pedal is initially at a resting position.
